extraction.Name: Benjamin Swallow
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want his patent to his allotment, on account of not wishing to pay the taxes, but that he was advised that he would be forced to take it, and pay taxes; he, therefore, accepted it
extraction.Buyer: Mortgaged to Oliver Swallow, Oelrichs, South Dakota, for $1000.00; sold to E.M. Coffield, of Oelrichs, South Dakota, for $1250.00, Mr. Coffield assuming the mortgage
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: part of it was to pay taxes on the allotment
extraction.Occupation/Income: working as a laborer for the Chicago & Northwestern Railroad Company
extraction.NOTES: Deponent states he is 24 years old in one passage and 34 years old in the opening sworn statement — likely a typographical inconsistency in the document; mortgaged allotment in 1920 to pay for wife's operation at an Omaha hospital; sold land in 1925; mentally competent; health is good except for stomach trouble; has a wife and four minor children to support; children all have good health; has never received any help from the County or Government | ORIGINAL_TRIBE_VALUE: "Shannon County / Pine Ridge area (State of South Dakota, County of Shannon)" (normalized 2026-04-28 to canonical 'Pine Ridge')
